Claim: PM loop round 8 (continued) — flight K, one governed objectui skills card: the published `skills/objectui` tree teaches the unexported `UIComponent` in five places (`guides/architecture.md` 22 · 46 · 76, `rules/protocol.md` 49 · 61); each becomes `BaseSchema`, the maintainer's ruled name for a component node (ruling 5556352576 on #7434), and the two fenced interface blocks take the same ruling the seat recorded on #8092 — every line that stays must be true of the real `BaseSchema` (drop `props`, `events` and any `ActionDef` reference; declare `hidden` / `disabled` / `children` as `packages/types/src/base.ts` does; one abridged note naming that file). The node-slot / union distinction is kept: `SchemaNode` is written nowhere new.
Session: `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`

Container & model: S, `mode:subagent`, opus — objectui carries no `dispatch-gates.mjs`; prose in a published skill, no contract accept/reject move.
Clause-②: no
Serial: no open PR touches these two files (flight G holds `guides/schema-expressions.md`; PR #8090 holds root `AGENTS.md`). GOVERNED (`skills/**`) ⇒ draft PR, in-seat review, `os-zhuang` + `hotlong`, human merge; objectui has no `skip-changeset` label — the changeset gate decides; at ACCEPT the seat adds `needs-user-decision` + the 维护者速读. The PR carries `Fixes #8065`.
